newsitem.title: USA: Compass file shelf for $100 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: Compass file shelf for $100 mln securities.

text.p: Two business trusts formed by Compass Bancshares said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $100 million in preferred securities, series A.
The trusts, known as Compass Trust I and Compass Trust II, will use the proceeds from the sale to buy junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Compass Bancshares.
The parent company will use the proceeds to be added to general corporate funds and will be used for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
The preferred securities, Series A, have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred security. The offering will be underwritten by Goldman Sachs & Co and Credit Suisse First Boston.
The Birmingham, Ala., bank holding company is engaged in commercial banking, trust services, data processing activities, real estate operations and other related financial services.
